ns2:section.sectionText: Synchronous attendance required. This seminar is designed to provide historical knowledge and understanding about the evolution of multicultural education in the United States. We will examine multiculturalism from its onset to prospective future evolution. There is a special focus on how multiculturalism has informed curriculum content and teacher education.
